purpose: Thumbnail-refresh queue. Target = high-retention + low-CTR videos where the thumbnail is the bottleneck. Active_queue = decisions to act on THIS week. Archive = concluded/parked history.
rule: AVD high + CTR below channel avg 3.68% = thumbnail-capped. Low AVD = retention problem, thumbnail won't fix (skip). CTR at/above avg = thumbnail fine, drop from queue.
monitor: 7-day window post-change. Hard-swap target: CTR +0.5pt. Test & Compare auto-keeps the winner.
